query: SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'signalType',signal_type,'targetType',target_type,'targetId',target_id,'score',score,'severity',severity,'status',status::text,'assignedUserId',assigned_user_id,'version',version,'createdAt',created_at,'duplicateSignalId',duplicate_signal_id,'duplicateRelationship',duplicate_relationship) ORDER BY created_at DESC),'[]'::jsonb) FROM core.anomaly_signals
